response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced, versatile engineer with 13+ years across web, backend, mobile and embedded work, a CS degree, and one clearly relevant high-scale credential (low-latency microservices handling millions of requests/second at Sociomantic/dunnhumby). However, the resume shows no evidence of the core domain this Principal role is built around: experimentation frameworks, A/B testing, feature flagging, telemetry/metrics infrastructure, or statistical analysis and bias detection. His titles have stayed at Senior/Staff in relatively small product teams, with little demonstrated cross-org technical leadership, multi-workstream ownership, or influence at enterprise scale expected at IC6. He could be a fit for a senior full-stack or platform tooling role, but for this specific growth/experimentation mandate he would be a stretch hire requiring significant domain ramp-up.
strengths: 13+ years broad engineering experience with a CS degree and multi-language depth
Real high-throughput distributed systems work (millions of req/sec, low-latency services)
Strong engineering-craft signal: TDD, CI/CD, open-source tooling, teaching and mentoring
concerns: No demonstrated experimentation, A/B testing, or feature-flighting platform experience
No evidence of telemetry/metrics infrastructure or statistical/data analysis depth
Scope and leadership appear below Principal/IC6 (no multi-team, cross-org initiatives)

key_factors.factor: Insufficient Principal-level scope and cross-team influence
Long tenure with distributed, high-scale production systems
